non_goals.rationale: No watcher or subscription model exists server-side; notification scope is fixed by D49.
No release entity exists; sprints carry delivery cadence.
Requires a cross-sprint timeline model; Schedule covers day-level planning per D22.
Needs a capacity model, deferred by D33.
Deferred by D33; story points plus historical velocity cover planning in v1.
Doubles board interaction complexity with no demand evidence; grouping is a later view option per D20.
parent_task_id exists and subtasks render, but an inline checklist UI is deferred.
Personal views ship first; org-shared views are v2.
No offline write queue exists in any client; realtime field deltas require connectivity per D48.
Buckets would become a second container competing with sprints; flat ranked list chosen per D20.
Bulk triage belongs in backlog; board bulk would double drag-and-drop complexity per D23.
Unrelated to backlog, sprint and schedule; explicitly untouched per D31.
